headline: Capex guidance raised, capitalisation trimmed

highlights: Underlying PAT growth was ~9% YoY before regulatory and one-off items, as per management’s earnings bridge.
Capitalisation stood at INR 40bn in Q2FY27 and INR 93bn in H1FY27, against the revised FY27 guidance of INR 250–300bn (earlier INR 300bn).
While this is below our/Street estimates, capex guidance was raised to INR 370–400bn, with H1 execution at INR 169bn.
Management expects annual capex of ~INR 400bn in FY28/29, with potential upside.

watch: The resumption of quarterly YoY PAT growth, strong capex visibility and sustained T&D bidding opportunities remain key positives.
